_comment: Canonical date-layer settings captured in the 18 Aug 2026 discovery session (docs/discovery/2026-08-date-layer-editor-notes.md). Values verified against API snapshots of Taylorsville (hand-built reference), San Antonio (generator-made), and Brigham City (added live during the session). No secrets in this file.
default_variant_note: Editor opens on graphite (variant-specific design). Switch to a light swatch first to edit the default design, which propagates to all non-specific variants.
dark_group_detection: group carries the white temple SVG asset (never keyed by colorway names)

personalization.instructions: Please add a date (accepted format: Month DD, YYYY)
personalization.note: The sales_channel_properties personalisation block rides the UI duplicate, but the editor requires the personalization text layer to be re-created per draft via the Personalize panel.

selectors._comment: Top-level controls verified against the live editor DOM in the 18 Aug discovery session. Panel-internal, swatch, and position-panel selectors below were re-verified live against the Brigham City draft (6a84639bd5ded88aa1075c8c) once the CDP connection blocker (see task-5-report.md) was fixed in scripts/printify_login.py. Every selector still marked with a 'note' is a deferred placeholder; everything else in this section was read directly from the live DOM this session (outerHTML dumps and/or successful read-only interaction), not guessed from prose.

layer_toolbar_font_dropdown.note: verified live: this is the first of three role=combobox elements in the selected-layer toolbar (font family, font size, zoom %), in that DOM order; the driver takes .first. No name filter because the accessible name is the current value ('Alata'), not a stable label.

layer_toolbar_color_hex_input.note: Verified live during the Task 6c supervised run: the hex field is the native <input> nested inside the <pfy-input data-testid="colorHexInput"> wrapper in the open color-picker popup. The prior bare "input" selector matched every input on the page (20 during this check) and would fail Playwright's strict mode on any fill(); scoped by data-testid it matches exactly one. Fill with the color minus its leading '#' (the '#' is a separate UI prefix glyph, not part of the field's own value), then Enter confirms it. The popup does not auto-close afterward (same as the font dropdown), so the driver presses Escape next.

info_modal.note: verified live: role=dialog wraps the whole 'Important product information' modal. Used only to check visibility before trying to close it.

info_modal_close_button.note: verified live by clicking it: the modal's close (X) button is the first <button> inside the dialog, before any other content. It carries no accessible name (icon-only, aria-hidden icon), so role/name lookup does not work; the driver takes .first.

existing_text_layer_marker.note: verified live on Brigham City: present exactly once on the back side (which already has its date layer) and absent on the front side of the same product. This is the layers-list entry's own marker attribute, not a text match, so it does not depend on the layer being named 'Text' or on font name.

variant_swatch_group.note: verified live: every color swatch in the 'Variants and layers' panel is a <button data-testid="colorChipButton" aria-label="<ColorName>">, confirmed for all 8 of Brigham City's colorways (Graphite, Brick, Ivory, Khaki, Moss, Ice Blue, True Navy, Orchid). Used by _select_group() only for the light-group path (iterates these and clicks the first whose aria-label is not in dark_colorways_for_reference); dark groups are clicked directly by role+name instead. The blue 'variant-specific design' dot is a pure CSS decoration with no distinguishing DOM attribute (every swatch's markup is structurally identical whether or not it shows a dot), so darkness cannot be read from this selector alone; see dark_colorways_for_reference and _select_group()'s docstring. _select_group() itself was exercised end to end this session (clicked Graphite, then a light swatch, then True Navy) and confirmed correct via the panel's 'Revert <name> to default design' text and the 'Currently editing variant specific design' status appearing/disappearing as expected.

text_input.note: verified live: reads back the exact placeholder value ('SEPTEMBER 25, 2024') on Brigham City's existing layer. Scoped to the layer's own container because an unrelated second, empty <textarea> exists elsewhere on the page; an unscoped 'textarea' selector picks up both and .first is not reliably the right one.

layer_toolbar_color_button.note: Verified live during the Task 6c supervised run (the deferred 5b confirmation): the toolbar's color control is the sole <button> inside the <pfd-text-color-dropdown> custom element (identified by its own pfytooltip="Font color" attribute, tooltip text 'Font color'). The real native <button> carries no aria-label at all; a non-standard "arialabel" attribute lives only on the wrapping <pfy-button> custom element and is never projected onto the actual button, which is why the prior aria-label-based guess matched zero elements. Clicking it opens a <pfd-color-picker> popup with a hex field; see layer_toolbar_color_hex_input.

width_input.note: verified live: reads back 7 on Brigham City's existing layer, matching config box_width_in and the discovery notes' calibration. Not a <label>-associated field (the visible 'Width' text is not programmatically linked), so get_by_label does not work here; use the data-testid instead.

height_input.note: verified live: reads back 0.91, matching config box_height_in.

position_left_input.note: verified live: reads back 26.64, matching position_left_pct_for_centered_7in and the discovery notes' calibration exactly.

position_top_input.note: verified live: reads back 79.93 on Brigham City's existing layer (the discovery notes recorded 80.05% for an earlier pass on the same product before a later one-down-arrow nudge; both are within the 0.005 verify tolerance).
